metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Depok, Indonesia (coordinates approximately -6.4, 106.8) - Dates: 1990 (Year 1) vs 2019 (Year 2) - Collection: Landsat for 1990 (Landsat 5 TM), Landsat for 2019 (Landsat 8 OLI) - Index: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as proxy for vegetation cover - NDVI = (NIR - RED) / (NIR + RED) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Mask clouds using QA_PIXEL band (Landsat) to avoid false low vegetation readings - Use quality flags to filter valid observations - Calculate mean NDVI for each year over a buffered region around Depok 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check collection sizes: if 0 images found → C1 - Check pixel counts after masking: if 0 valid pixels → C2 - Check NDVI result: if NaN or out of range [-1, 1] → C3 - Compare NDVI values: if 2019_NDVI < 1990_NDVI → A (Yes, lower), else → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Depok region const depokCoords = ee.Geometry.Point([106.8, -6.4]); const depokBuffer = depokCoords.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer // 1990: Landsat 5 TM const col1990 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(depokBuffer) .filterDate('1990-01-01', '1990-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size1990 = col1990.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1990 Images: ${size1990}`); if (size1990 === 0) { console.log('No data for 1990.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 2019: Landsat 8 OLI const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(depokBuffer) .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Function to calculate NDVI const calcNDVI = (col, suffix) => { const ndviCol = col.map(img => { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); const mask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0); // Clear pixels return ndvi.updateMask(mask); }); const meanNDVI = ndviCol.mean(); const count = meanNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: depokBuffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndviVal = meanNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: depokBuffer, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`${suffix} - NDVI: ${(ndviVal || 'null').toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count || 0}`); return { ndvi: ndviVal, count: count }; }; const result1990 = calcNDVI(col1990, '1990'); const result2019 = calcNDVI(col2019, '2019'); // Validation if (result1990.count === 0 || result2019.count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (result1990.ndvi === null || result2019.ndvi === null || isNaN(result1990.ndvi) || isNaN(result2019.ndvi)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid NDVI.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (result1990.ndvi < -1 || result1990.ndvi > 1 || result2019.ndvi < -1 || result2019.ndvi > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Was 2019 lower than 1990? const isLower = result2019.ndvi < result1990.ndvi; console.log(`Comparison: 2019 (${result2019.ndvi.toFixed(3)}) < 1990 (${result1990.ndvi.toFixed(3)})? ${isLower}`); if (isLower) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
